# pai git

Link commits to the session that wrote them

```
pai git <command>
```

Installs a post-commit hook that records the session and worker that edited a commit's files as a git note (ref pai).

```sh
pai git setup
pai git notes
pai git remove
```

See also: `pai worker ps`

### pai git setup

Install the post-commit hook in the current repository

```
pai git setup
```

Writes .git/hooks/post-commit, keeping an existing hook as post-commit.pre-pai and calling it first, and sets notes.rewriteRef so notes follow amends and rebases.

```sh
pai git setup
```

### pai git remove

Remove the hook and restore the previous one

```
pai git remove
```

Deletes the PAI post-commit hook, puts a chained hook back and unsets notes.rewriteRef.

```sh
pai git remove
```

### pai git notes

Show the PAI note of a commit

```
pai git notes [REV]
```

Prints the session and worker recorded for a commit (default HEAD), or 'no PAI note'.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `REV` | no | Commit to show (default HEAD) |

```sh
pai git notes
pai git notes HEAD~1
```

### pai git hook

Git hook entry points (called by git)

```
pai git hook <command>
```

Internal: `pai git hook post-commit` is what the installed hook runs. Always exits 0.

```sh
pai git hook post-commit
```

#### pai git hook post-commit

Record the sessions that edited the last commit's files

```
pai git hook post-commit
```

Skips during rebase and cherry-pick; looks back 6 hours in the raw captures. Always exits 0.

```sh
pai git hook post-commit
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai git setup` | Install the post-commit hook in the current repository |
| `pai git remove` | Remove the hook and restore the previous one |
| `pai git notes` | Show the PAI note of a commit |
| `pai git hook` | Git hook entry points (called by git) |
